english:
Precision Kills grant stacks of Precision Equity based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File: 1 stack
• Elite: 2 stacks
• Miniboss: 5 stacks
• Champion+: 10 stacks

Stacks cannot exceed 10.

Reaching 10 stacks consumes all of them to spawn a massive Orb of Power, which grants 12.5% Super Energy when collected.

Collecting the massive Orb grants Weapon Surge x2 for 11 seconds. Weapon Surge x2 does not overwrite stronger Weapon Surges and works for all damage types.

source.text:
Precision Kills grant stacks of Precision Equity, up to 10 stacks.
Rank-and-File = 1 | Elite = 2 | Miniboss = 5 | Champion+ = 10
Does not overflow or retains stacks past x10.

Upon reaching x10 stacks:
Consumes all stacks to spawn a MASSIVE Orb of Power.
Globe of Power grants 12.5% Super Energy.

On GIGA ORB OF POWER PICKUP:
Weapon Surge x2 for 11 seconds.
Does not overwrite stronger Weapon Surges.
Works for all damage types.
